About
Incorporated in 1895, Grob Tea Co. Ltd is primarily engaged in growing and manufacture of Tea besides trading busines.
[1]
Key Points
Business Overview:
[1]
The Company owns six tea estates: Doyang, Dessoi, Kanu, Teen Ali, Pathemara, and Martycherra, located across the premium tea-growing regions of Assam and Cachar, with a total tea plantation area of
2,332.71 hectares
and an annual production capacity of ~47 lakh kg of tea.
Acquired by the Rawalwasia Group in 2009, the Company has modernised its plantations and manufacturing facilities, increased production capacity, and continues to focus on plantation development, operational efficiency, and capacity expansion through consolidation and modernization
